truth.days: latent multi-day trip; days_exact = share with the right day count
truth.length / max_length: share of the latent comfortable band inside the stated window
truth.mtb: latent style is mountain biking (cycling personas only)
truth.train / public_transport: latent transport is train (the judge treats it as a hard wish)

accept_if: paired bootstrap 95% CI of mean NDCG@10(variant) - NDCG@10(recsys_serve) on dev has lower bound > 0
mean Violations@10 on dev not above recsys_serve's
the stage's own compute adds < 20 ms at p95 (local)
rule.choose: among accepted variants, the larger mean dev NDCG@10 difference; none accepted -> stage off
rule.extractor_gate: a need with a latent counterpart is enabled only with dev precision >= 0.8
